behavior: The job tests size their own database pool, so they pass on a 2-CPU CI runner and staging CI finishes
acceptance: In a 2-CPU Linux container (docker --cpuset-cpus=0,1) go test -race ./internal/job passes; on main it times out in TestAcceptMakesTheDepositOnce, which needs 7 connections and gets pgxpool's default of 4
notes: 2026-10-21 review pass by reviewer: Reasoning holds: the 5-accept test needs 7 connections (held lock, 5 Accept txs blocked on the profile FOR UPDATE, the pg_stat_activity poll) and pgx v5.11.0 defaults to max(4, NumCPU); pool_max_conns=8 covers it, all other job tests need at most 4, and the url+"&pool_max_conns=..." pattern matches TestPoolSizeFromTheURL (it relies on DATABASE_URL carrying a non-pool param like sslmode, true for .env.example and CI). In a 2-CPU container all DB packages pass, internal/job included; no other package holds N+2>4 connections at once. Diff is one line plus a why-comment and tasks.json, commit has no AI attribution.

proof.1: unit: in a 2-CPU Linux container (docker --cpuset-cpus=0,1, golang:1.27.2) go test -race ./internal/job timed out on main after 2m in TestAcceptMakesTheDepositOnce and passes on this branch in 5.1s; staging run 39680914616 failed the same way (internal/job 600.086s)
